question: On learning about the Jallianwala Bagh massacre, ______ expressed the pain and anger of the country by renouncing his knighthood.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rabindranath Tagore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rabindranath Tagore, **a celebrated author and poet, **renounced his knighthood in protest of the Jallianwala Bagh massacre in 1919.**
 
• Tagore wrote a letter to the** Viceroy of India, expressing his repugnance and sorrow over the brutal incident.**
 
• His act was a form of protest against British policies in India.
 
• **Tagore was the first non-European and the first lyricist to win the Nobel Prize in Literature.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**
